[[File:Ring of pursuit detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''ring of pursuit''' is an [[opal ring]] enchanted via the [[Lvl-1 Enchant]] spell. When worn, it will reveal the entire track of [[hunter creatures]] (excluding [[herbiboar]]s) caught via [[noose wand]]. The ring will provide 10 charges before disappearing. 

The number of charges is specific to the player, not the ring, so swapping, dropping, or casting [[alchemy spells]] on rings before all charges are used will '''not''' reset the number of charges the player has left before a ring breaks. Players can right-click a ring of pursuit to either "check" how many charges remain in it or "break" it and reset the next one they use to its maximum charges.
